public.title: Styled Text Ranges IV
public.description: input {length,ranges,patches}; ranges are sorted disjoint [start,end,styleObject] triples. Each style object has string keys and primitive values. Patches {start,end,style} shallow-merge properties over each covered position; a null property deletes that key. Empty style objects mean unstyled. Return sorted maximal [start,end,styleObject] triples, omit empty styles and merge adjacent structurally equal styles regardless of key insertion order. Length at most 100, at most 8 style keys. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, fixtures and reference solutions, 2026. Covers a common JavaScript practice topic; no third-party exercise text or implementation copied.

explanation: Maintain shallow property maps per character, delete null-patched properties and coalesce canonical key/value encodings. O(length times (ranges plus patches times keys plus keys log keys)) time and O(length times keys) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
